resources.string: Every lab plays the same 20 second test video: four video renditions (216p, 360p, 540p and 720p, from 200 kbit/s to 2 Mbit/s) and one audio track, cut into 2 second CMAF segments. One set of segments is described twice, by an HLS master playlist and by a DASH manifest. A small HTTP server inside the app serves them on the loopback address, and every byte goes through a bandwidth shaper that follows the network trace you pick.
No requests yet. Fetch a manifest, or play a stream in another lab.
